english: What is this that you have done?

urhobo_raw: Die wo rori vwo ru emu nana?
urhobo_toned: Die wo róri vwo ru emú nana?
english: What did you think to do this thing?

urhobo_raw: Tivọ wo nurhe ki tivọ wọ je ra?
urhobo_toned: Tivọ́ wo núrhe ki tivọ́ wọ je rá?
english: Where have you come from, and where are you going?
Do not pass by your servant.

urhobo_raw: Gba ro evun rẹ okọ na.
urhobo_toned: Gba ro evún rẹ ókọ̀ na.

english: I have brought forth a person.
